geography: Worldwide (U.S. in practice; Int'l. column nil to very small)
moa: Dopamine D3/D2 receptor partial agonist (atypical antipsychotic)
series_start_reason: AbbVie-reported series starts 2020Q3. AbbVie closed the Allergan acquisition on May 8, 2020 and its 2020Q2 release prints Vraylar $192 million that, by its own footnote, covers only 'Allergan product revenues from the date of the acquisition, May 8, 2020, through June 30, 2020' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000155115220000019/abbv-20200630xexhibit991.htm), a part-quarter that is not comparable with a full quarter; it is therefore not included. Allergan plc's own full-quarter series 2016Q1-2020Q1 is staged as allergan_vraylar; no issuer printed a full 2020Q2 Vraylar quarter.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms, incl. 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K) for CIK 0001551152 (AbbVie), 0000001800 (Abbott), 0001578845 (Allergan plc / Actavis plc), 0000855654 (ImmunoGen) and 0000850693 (Allergan, Inc.) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (scripts/list_filings.py); earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02 (also item 12 / 7,9 for 2003-2004 Abbott and Allergan, Inc. filings), exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (scripts/earnings.py, exhibits.py).

Product rows pulled by table-row parsing of each earnings exhibit (scripts/abbvie_extract.py, abbott_extract.py, allergan_extract.py, allerganinc_extract.py); the quarter of an AbbVie block is read from the document's own '% Change vs. nQyy' header row; every series was checked for gaps and, where the Q4 release prints a full-year figure, quarters were summed against it (scripts/build_all.py).

Compared the AbbVie 2020-07-29 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1551152/000110465920087827/tm2025879d1_ex99-1.htm): it prints AbbVie's as-reported 1Q19-1Q20 quarterly trend (Vraylar nil, pre-acquisition) and a pro forma 'comparable historical' block; no pro forma 2020Q2 is published, so 2020Q2 is a gap between allergan_vraylar and this series.
Four quarters of 2021-2025 sum to the printed full-year figures.
